description: This is a unit test class for PredefinedShelfService, testing functionalities such as finding shelves by ID, saving shelves, retrieving shelves for the logged-in user, and handling enumeration-based shelf name lookups.

classes.name: PredefinedShelfServiceTest
classes.description: Unit test suite for the PredefinedShelfService class, testing its methods for correct behavior and exception handling.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes mocks and the service instance before each test.

methods.name: findById_throwsNullPointerException_ifIdIsNull
methods.description: Ensures that calling findById with a null ID throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: canFindByNonNullId
methods.description: Verifies that findById with a non-null ID interacts with the repository.

methods.name: save_throwsNullPointerException_ifNullPredefinedShelf
methods.description: Ensures saving null PredefinedShelf throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: saveNonNullPredefinedShelf
methods.description: Tests that saving a valid PredefinedShelf invokes the repository save method.

methods.name: canFindAllForLoggedInUser
methods.description: Checks retrieval of all shelves for the current user.

methods.name: canFindToReadShelf
methods.description: Verifies find operation for the 'To Read' predefined shelf.

methods.name: canFindReadingShelf
methods.description: Verifies find operation for the 'Reading' predefined shelf.

methods.name: canFindReadShelf
methods.description: Verifies find operation for the 'Read' predefined shelf.

methods.name: canFindDidNotFinishShelf
methods.description: Verifies find operation for the 'Did Not Finish' predefined shelf.

methods.name: canCount
methods.description: Checks that the count method calls the repository's count.

methods.name: isPredefinedShelf_throwsNullPointerException_ifShelfNameIsNull
methods.description: Ensures that passing null to isPredefinedShelf throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: getPredefinedShelfName_throwsNullPointerException_ifShelfNameIsNull
methods.description: Ensures that passing null to getPredefinedShelfName throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: canFindValidPredefinedShelfName
methods.description: Tests that each valid enum value can be correctly parsed from string.

methods.name: getPredefinedShelfName_returnsEmpty_ifNotMatched
methods.description: Checks that an invalid string yields an empty Optional.

methods.name: deleteAll_callsRepository
methods.description: Verifies that deleteAll invokes the repository's deleteAll method.
